items.html: And it has already been explained that the verse, “And He said, Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh” [I will be that I will be], is expounded upon regarding this matter. Know that these two supernal Ehyeh of the Yudin mentioned here are the two names of Ehyeh in the aforementioned verse, “And He said, Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh,” which are in the Hochma and Bina of the ten Sefirot of the throat, that is, Bina; and the Keter of these ten Sefirot of the throat is alluded to in the word Asher [“that”] between the two names of Ehyeh, for it is the middle line between Hochma and Bina.
